bluetooth_confirm.title: FNIRSI FNB58 USB Fast Charge Tester
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up {name}?

Read-only over Bluetooth: voltage, current and power, plus energy and capacity totalled in Home Assistant. The meter cannot be controlled from Home Assistant over Bluetooth. It does not need to stay powered on; Home Assistant reconnects whenever it is switched on and in range. Unplug USB data when using Bluetooth.

data_description.address: Pick a discovered meter, or type its Bluetooth address (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). If nothing is listed, switch the meter on, keep it in range, and unplug USB data.
